name: Gill Lovecraft
source:
A freelance editor who is in charge of editing magazines, books, and news sites. 2 years ago, in order to get over his heartbreak feeling, he joined the Cupid Corporation. However, because he compared everything to his unrequited love, he became a troublesome member of [Parasite5].

His unrequited love was back in his freshman university days and the heroine who became his roommate. He dedicated himself to supporting her who was ignorant of the world (because she had just come to the human world) and came to fell for her. But for him whose feelings went unnoticed, this led to his heartbreak and decision to no longer be roommates.

This time he is reunited with the heroine as his own adviser and so the gears of love that stopped before have started to move again.
